title: Vacancy contract
description: Structured vacancy written by the vacancy reader to runs/<job-id>/vacancy.json. Every key of the version is present; null means the page has no value.

site.description: Site key: the host without www., lowercased.

extracted_by.description: How the fields were extracted: by a site rule or by the LLM fallback.

fetched_at.description: When the page was fetched, ISO 8601 date-time.

title.description: Job title, plain text, one line.

company.description: Hiring company name, plain text, one line.

hiring_manager.description: Hiring manager or recruiter, plain text.

tags.description: Short labels shown for the vacancy; null when the page shows none, never an empty list.
